name: Farhanul Islam
title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
tagline: Ensuring high-quality software through manual & automated testing, API and UI validation, and defect tracking.
about: Motivated QA Engineer aiming to ensure high-quality software through effective manual and automated testing, API and UI validation, defect tracking, and close collaboration with development teams.

Most recently I worked as a Junior Software Quality Assurance Engineer at Betopia Group, building test plans and strategies for web and mobile enterprise applications, running regression, smoke and sanity testing, validating UI/UX against Figma designs, and supporting automation with Selenium and Playwright.

I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering from International Islamic University Chittagong (2021 – 2025), and completed QA training and certifications from Test Automation University, 10PEARLS University, EDGE-CSE CUET and IT Training Bd.
